sources.quote: HD 145457 is a star located in the northern constellation of Corona Borealis at a distance of around 442 light-years from the Sun, as determined through parallax measurements.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.1 solar radii and 2.80 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,939 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.label: Creevey et al. (2023), Astronomy & Astrophysics 674 A26

sources.quote: It has been formally named Kamuy by the IAU, after a spiritual or divine being in Ainu mythology.
